ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects the key financial terms found in the source document. All major elements are properly supported:

- Deal size of USD 225,000,000 matches the Incremental Revolving Commitments amount specified in the source
- The borrower (Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc.) and guarantors are correctly identified
- The date (August 18, 2022) is accurate
- The covenant terms regarding Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio being maintained 0.25:1.00 below permitted levels is directly quoted from Section 6(e)
- The administrative agent (Bank of America, N.A.) and participating lenders are correctly listed
- References to Term A Loan repayment, convertible notes, and solvency requirements are all present in the source document
- Items marked as "N/A" (interest rate, maturity date, payment frequency) are appropriately noted as such since these terms are not specified in this amendment document

The memo appropriately limits itself to information explicitly contained in the source document and does not fabricate any key financial terms.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
• Total facility size after amendment ($575,000,000 aggregate revolving credit commitments)
• Original credit agreement date (May 24, 2022)
• Amendment effective date (August 18, 2022)
• Specific lender allocation amounts (referenced in Schedule 1 but amounts not detailed in memo)
• Term A Loan repayment requirement as condition precedent
• Breakage payment obligations related to loan adjustments
• Know-your-customer and beneficial ownership certification requirements with specific timing (7-day and 5-day notice periods)
